note: Dave 3 Nov 2026: grass is full density (and tall grass drawn) out to fade_start_share of the grass radius, then thins gradually to far_share of the cards at the edge; tall grass fades to tall_far_share (none) by 80 percent of the radius. fade_start_share is THE setting to change: 0.5 = start at half the draw distance, 0.25 = start at a quarter.
